solutions.intro: Each case is a typical challenge we solve for our clients. Figures are based on averages after implementing AI agents in similar projects.

support.title: Customer support automation
support.problem: A team of 5 agents couldn't keep up with 200+ daily inquiries. Average response time: 4 hours — customers went to competitors.
support.solution: We deployed a first-line AI agent: resolves 80% of typical inquiries instantly and hands off complex cases to a human agent with full context.

leads.title: Lead qualification in CRM
leads.problem: Sales reps spent 3 hours daily processing inquiries: clarifying needs, filling CRM, and scheduling meetings.
leads.solution: The AI agent receives inquiries from all channels, asks qualifying questions, scores the lead, and creates a CRM record with priority.

documents.title: Document processing
documents.problem: Employees manually extracted data from 500+ documents per month: invoices, contracts, statements. Errors in 12% of cases.
documents.solution: The AI agent recognizes, classifies, and extracts key fields from documents, loading data into the accounting system.

ecommerce.title: Online store consultant
ecommerce.problem: Shoppers couldn't find the right product in a catalog of 3,000 items. 40% left without purchasing.
ecommerce.solution: AI consultant on the website: helps choose products, compares features, and enables one-click ordering.

scheduling.title: Booking & scheduling
scheduling.problem: Administrators spent 4 hours daily on calls for appointments, rescheduling, and reminders.
scheduling.solution: The AI agent manages appointments via messaging and web, syncs with the calendar, and sends reminders.

portfolio.title: Work Examples
portfolio.subtitle: Real AI implementation case studies
portfolio.description: Publicly documented AI agent implementations across industries. AI-Agentes designs and deploys similar solutions.
portfolio.intro: Below are real cases from global practice: railways, industry, fintech, e-commerce, and B2B. We study the best implementations and adapt proven architectures to our clients' needs.
portfolio.disclaimer: Cases are based on public reports from companies and their technology partners (AWS, OpenAI, Enterprise Bot, ChatSignals, etc.).

cp.title: AI chatbot on web and WhatsApp for 200M passengers
cp.challenge: Portugal's state railway operator serves ~200 million passengers per year. Support was overwhelmed: inquiries about schedules, delays, refunds, and ticket sales required human agents and created long queues.
cp.solution: They implemented an AI chatbot on web and WhatsApp integrated with ticket sales systems and delay APIs. The bot responds in 130+ languages (web) and in Portuguese (WhatsApp).

siemens.title: AI agent for contact center with CRM integration
siemens.challenge: Global corporation with enormous call volume managed by an outdated IVR. Customers waited too long and routing often sent them to the wrong specialist.
siemens.solution: They deployed an AI agent on Amazon Connect with access to CRM, employee directory, and knowledge base via Lambda. It personalizes dialogue based on purchase history and transfers to a human with full context.

stannp.title: Sales chat automation with HubSpot
stannp.challenge: A team of 7 sales reps spent most of their time on routine chats instead of closing deals and expanding into new markets. Launching in Canada was impossible due to lack of resources.
stannp.solution: They implemented AI chat integrated with HubSpot: the bot handles typical inquiries, qualifies leads, and transfers hot opportunities to sales reps. Freed-up reps focused on international expansion.

retailer.title: AI chatbot + CRM workflow automation
retailer.challenge: Slow responses, high support load, and manual CRM work: lead assignment, follow-up, and reporting. Teams spent hours on repetitive operations.
retailer.solution: They deployed a multichannel chatbot (web, app, social) with NLP connected to Salesforce/Zoho CRM. Automated lead routing, reminders, and reporting dashboards.

klarna.title: AI support assistant in 35+ languages
klarna.challenge: Fintech service with 150M users across 23 markets processed millions of inquiries: refunds, disputes, payments. Average resolution time: 11 minutes, call center load kept growing.
klarna.solution: They launched an LLM-based AI assistant: multilingual 24/7 support, handling refunds and payments. Hybrid model: AI closes typical cases, humans step in for complex cases and premium customers.

logistics.title: AI Sidekick — assistant for 2M+ merchants
logistics.challenge: Millions of merchants manage catalogs, orders, and marketing daily. New users struggle with the tools and support doesn't scale linearly.
logistics.solution: They implemented Sidekick — an AI assistant in the admin panel: answers questions about store setup, generates product descriptions, analyzes sales, and suggests actions in natural language.
